description: Engine context API slice for #768 stacked after .3.1: extend Conversations for one canonical message associated to multiple transcripts, serial per-transcript committed sequence allocation, idempotent source/account key and reattachment, and transcript-path-only authorized reads; reject nil Person and mismatched provider/account/permission scopes. Preserve existing conversation-scoped legacy Message reads until .15 migrates/cuts over. Tests FIRST: one message/multi-transcript; duplicate/reordered/concurrent association; unauthorized direct-id/attachment/trace access; ownership conflict, rollback, and per-transcript cursor position on old attach. Reuse Conversations and ChannelHistoryResource/Permissions as appropriate; no parallel Action/tool (internal Engine persistence). No external mocks; DB integration and property tests. Read Engine guide, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md; update docs/services/engine.md. No new feature E2E before zaq-emb.12 UX approval.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 Action reuse assessment for authorized canonical append/read: existing Conversations.add_message/2 and persist_message_history/2 are conversation-scoped, trigger legacy telemetry/title behavior and cannot attach a single UUID to multiple transcripts; Message.canonical_changeset/2 and new Transcript/TranscriptMessage schemas are structural reuse candidates. ChannelHistoryResource.for/3 + can_read?/2 and Permissions grant path already implement Direct/Shared direct-Person grants; Replicated recipient owner is explicit owner_person_id. Decision: extend Engine Conversations with local-only transaction writer/read methods (or one delegated internal storage module) sharing Message.canonical_changeset, not a new agent Action: raw transcript append accepts trusted Channels/Engine normalized identity but would be unsafe for agent/workflow arbitrary inputs; BO consumer must use NodeRouter when exposed later. Contract: provider/config/account scope verified against persisted transcript before append, dedup by guaranteed provider account external ID and reject conflicting content, row-lock transcript for commit-order sequence, no-id deliveries are not deduped by guess; reader requires persisted Person + direct grant or Replicated owner and returns only sanitized content/descriptors, never private trace/metadata. Nil Person denied; no direct-id public read. Tests first: replay/concurrent/association old message, mismatched scope, denied reads, cursor bounds, rollback. Strategy decisions and recipient evidence remain .14; legacy cutover .15. No new feature E2E before human UX approval.

2026-09-26 Action discovery recheck: inspected Zaq.Agent.Tools.Conversations.PersistMessageHistory (workflow Action, lib/zaq/agent/tools/conversations/persist_message_history.ex) and its contract tests. It accepts agent/workflow-supplied Incoming/routing and stamps conversation identity via Channels before Engine :persist_message_history; stores exactly one legacy conversation-scoped message, not one canonical UUID with multiple authorized transcript placements. Reusing it for passive/background shared history would expose an unsafe agent input surface and duplicate legacy telemetry/title side effects. Decision remains Engine-local Conversations append/list delegating to TranscriptHistory, no Registry entry or new Action. The future strategy consumer uses trusted channel ingress through NodeRouter; current API not exposed as arbitrary Agent action. Verification: test-first public context API regressions plus existing legacy Conversation/permission tests.

2026-09-26 implementation on feature/issue-768-canonical-transcript-api: Conversations delegates internal append/list to TranscriptHistory. Append checks persisted retrieval connector/provider, rejects archived ingress, verifies channel permission coordinate/parent strategy, requires Replicated recipient match, derives provider+connector+mailbox source key, uses partial-index conflict target and content conflict validation, locks transcript FOR UPDATE and increments next_position only for new association; no provider ID means no guessed dedup. Read requires persisted Person + direct grant for Direct/Shared or owner for Replicated; pages bounded by cursor/up-to/limit; returns only content and primitive attachment descriptors. Descriptor sanitization happens before DB insert and again on read. Legacy rate_message_by_id now rejects conversation-less canonical UUID, preventing crash/unauthorized mutation. Test-first regressions demonstrate missing APIs, null-content replay bug, bogus Person, and raw attachment persistence; focused 193 tests/6 properties plus mix q passed before latest narrow test additions, and current 13 new tests/1 property pass. Shared sandbox task test checks overlapping append positions but cannot prove multi-connection lock contention; database row lock and unique constraints provide cross-connection enforcement. #807 prerequisite CI green; no new-feature E2E authored.

2026-09-26 final issue-level validation on staged scope: 194 focused tests/6 properties, 0 failures across canonical schema/store, legacy Conversations and Permissions; mix q passed, staged diff --check clean. Existing Action PersistMessageHistory intentionally not reused because agent/workflow input and one-conversation semantics cannot safely represent passive canonical fanout. Observed overlap task test uses DataCase shared sandbox, so do not claim independent Postgres-connection contention tested; unique constraints plus FOR UPDATE implement serial committed positions. No new-feature E2E until human UX approval; raw traces/rating UUID path guarded.
